raw_market.description:
In the first half of the NFL game between Seahawks and Broncos, scheduled for October 15 at 8:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Broncos score 17 or more points in the first half.

If the Broncos score less than 17 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on the Broncos's first half score.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
